content.short: RubyDex is a Layer-2 derivatives DEX offering the trading experience of a CEX.
content.description: RubyDex provides access to linear perpetual futures across multiple chains while you retain full custody of your funds. Centralized exchanges offer convenience and speed at the cost of fund control, whereas decentralized options keep control but can limit functionality and performance. RubyDex balances these trade-offs by delivering robust trading tools with true self-custody, enabling cross-chain trading, advanced order types, and integrated risk management from a single, user-friendly platform.
